items.title: General Electric (GE) Names Darin DiTommaso Interim Head Of Defense And Systems
items.summary: General Electric (NYSE:GE) said GE Aerospace President and CEO of Defense and Systems Amy Gowder is leaving the business. The division will be led on an interim basis by Darin DiTommaso, according to the leadership announcement. Gowder's departure affects a unit that oversees key defense programs and engine partnerships within GE Aerospace. The leadership shift from Amy Gowder to interim head Darin DiTommaso is only one piece of the wider GE story. We have also spotted 1 warning sign worth...
